transduction.concept: Email addresses as biological transduction — horizontal gene transfer through @ routing
transduction.mechanism: The @ symbol creates taxonomy. address@domain routes information by phenotype, not identity.
examples: newsletter@primals.eco → broadcast to all who phenotyped into the culture
science@primals.eco → routes to those expressing the science receptor
art@primals.eco → routes to those expressing the art receptor
doctor.k@primals.eco → character transduction, DNA pickup from Half-Life
catch-all → ANY address works = ANY phage can dock
transduction.biology: Transduction: bacteriophage picks up random DNA from one host, injects it into another. The phage doesn't choose what DNA it carries. The RECIPIENT decides what to express. Email routing = phage routing. The newsletter doesn't know who needs it. The recipient's phenotype (subscriptions, interests, group membership) determines expression.
transduction.rss_bridge: RSS feeds ARE the genome. Email transduction picks up fragments and delivers them to new hosts. The @ taxonomy sorts the fragments by receptor type.
